title: Three open strings: G, B and E
summary: Your first three notes need no fretting at all.

steps.title: Three notes to start
text: Start with three notes you can play without fretting anything: the open **3rd**, **2nd** and **1st** strings.

steps.title: Where they sit
text: **G** is on the second line from the bottom. **B** is on the middle line. **E** is in the top space.
The circled number above a note is the string. The small number beside it is the finger, and **0** means open.

steps.title: Up and down
text: Press **Your turn**. After four clicks, play one note on each click.
For now every note lasts one click. The next lesson explains why.

steps.title: Mix them up
text: The same three notes in a different order. Look at whether each note is on a line or in a space before you play it.

steps.title: Without the names
text: Four bars of open strings. The string numbers now appear only at the start of each bar, so read the rest from the staff.
